ENGLISH — MOCK EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 8
SUBJECT: ENGLISH
TIME ALLOWED: 2 hours
TOTAL MARKS: 80
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----

   B. Use insults to “practise” Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   C. Avoid reading anything related to Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.
   D. Copy random text without understanding Grammar in Use 15.3.1 Types of Sentences: Interrogative sentences.

5. A paragraph should usually have: (1 mark)
   A. Many unrelated topics with no link
   B. No full stops
   C. Only one word repeated
   D. One main idea with supporting sentences
